messages:
Sam Mitchell: FYI — quick recap from the bridge. We paged at 03:12 UTC for elevated 5xx rate; cascading retries caused burst errors to the hosted inference pool. oncall rerouted traffic to the fallback model cluster around 03:19 and we saw error rate drop.
Oncall Bot: Incident 2026-03-14-03:12 triggered: api-errors-high (sev2) — assigned to Evan - EngOncall.
Evan - EngOncall: logging the timeline here. root cause looks like an autoscaler bug where new worker pods failed liveness checks under hot-start pressure. KV cache thrash amplified load.
Mariela Chen: Are we sure the KV cache issue was causal and not just correlated? any evidence from traces?
Evan - EngOncall: traces show the tail latency spike preceded worker terminations. I'll paste the relevant span after I pull it.
Jordan Kaur: Customer-impact note — three customers saw degraded responses (timeouts then 502s). Priya, can you confirm who to notify and whether any paid contracts hit SLOs?
Priya Patel (CSE): I have the list. Two enterprise customers (Acme and Orion) had >2min degraded windows. Acme is on a dedicated plan; we're preparing a tailored note.
Alex R - SRE: Quick mitigation checklist that we ran: 1) routed traffic to model-variant-b fallback 2) scaled up warm pool (manual) 3) disabled autoscaler for the pool temporarily 4) flushed partial KV cache to prevent thrash.
Sam Mitchell: Good. We need an action tracker and an owner for each. Also schedule the postmortem and decide what we share with Acme/Orion. Suggest timeline: internal PM + RCA draft by EOD tomorrow, customer-friendly RCA within 48 hours. Thoughts?
Jordan Kaur: Agree with timelines. I can coordinate the customer note with Priya. Priya — can you draft an exec-summary with impact numbers and a bullet list of remediation steps we’ll take? Keep it non-technical.
Priya Patel (CSE): Yep — will have a draft by 10:00 PT tomorrow.
Evan - EngOncall: Action items I'll own: - collect traces and full worker pod logs (owner: Evan) - reproduce autoscaler behavior in staging (owner: Alex & Evan) - propose autoscaler fix + test plan (owner: Alex)
Alex R - SRE: I'll start a staging reproduce now. ETA 6 hours for initial repro.
Mariela Chen: I'll own the postmortem doc structure and the quality regression check (evals) to ensure fallback didn't degrade outputs. Will also add a section for "what we monitored and why it wasn't caught earlier".
Sam Mitchell: OK owners consolidated. I'll own the public status page blurb and the follow-up commit timeline. Priya and Jordan, loop me in for tone.
Oncall Bot: Update: Incident 2026-03-14-03:19 mitigated (traffic routed to fallback cluster). Status: monitoring.
Jordan Kaur: Quick ask — do we have a list of customers who had retries or duplicate tokens billed? Billing team will need that. Priya, can you flag that for finance?
Priya Patel (CSE): Flagging now. Also starting a customer outreach plan: 1) immediate acknowledgement, 2) within-48hr RCA, 3) follow-up call offer for impacted enterprise customers.
Evan - EngOncall: Preliminary root cause statement: "Autoscaler race during hot-start under KV-cache churn causing worker liveness failures and cascading retries." Need to validate but it's the working hypothesis.
Mariela Chen: For remediation, propose: - autoscaler fix to account for startup liveness hysteresis - warm-pool size adjustment and improved warm-start health probing - KV cache backpressure throttling when worker allocation lags - add an anomaly alert for worker churn + retry amplification pattern
Sam Mitchell: Add a short-term config freeze for that pool while we test autoscaler changes. Also, let's add a rollback plan if the autoscaler change causes regressions.
Alex R - SRE: Noted. I'll prepare a rollback runbook in the change PR.
Jordan Kaur: Can someone add the timeline entry for customer communications to the incident doc? I want to ensure we don't send anything until the engineering fix plan is committed to avoid mixed messages.
Priya Patel (CSE): I'll add the communication schedule. Draft timeline: "acknowledgement within 4 hours" (sent), "initial technical summary within 24 hours" (planned), "full RCA within 48 hours" (planned), "follow-up remediation status within 7 days" (planned).
Sam Mitchell: Good. Also add a section: compensation discussion — mark for finance review.
Evan - EngOncall: Quick data point: total impacted requests ~ 12k across the window, error uplift peaked at 18% for the pool.
Mariela Chen: That metric is helpful for the evals team. I'll schedule an automated eval to check sample outputs from fallback vs primary to detect any quality regressions.
Oncall Bot: Note: Incident 2026-03-14-03:12 assigned severity: 2. Incident status changed to: post-incident review.
Sam Mitchell: Next steps summary (I'll post to the incident doc): - Owners: Evan (traces/logs + repro), Alex (autoscaler PR + rollback runbook), Mariela (postmortem doc + evals), Priya + Jordan (customer comms), Sam (status page + coordination). - Deliverables & deadlines: internal RCA draft by EOD tomorrow, customer-friendly RCA 48hrs, autoscaler PR proposal in 72hrs, follow-up status in 7 days.
Jordan Kaur: I'll sync with legal on wording as well for enterprise comms.
Priya Patel (CSE): Copy — scheduling calls with Acme & Orion for tomorrow afternoon. Will include engineering on the call if requested.
Sam Mitchell: Thanks everyone. For transparency, I'll create a short public status page entry that just says: "We experienced elevated errors affecting some requests; mitigation complete; detailed RCA forthcoming." I'll share the draft for a quick review.
Alex R - SRE: One more technical action: add rate-limiting backpressure gate to the host-proxy to prevent retries from amplifying failures. I'm adding that as an R&D task, owner: Alex.
Mariela Chen: Noted. Also will tag this incident for a retrospective with infra + runtime teams to review autoscaler assumptions.
Evan - EngOncall: I'll attach logs and spans to the incident doc in ~2 hours.
Priya Patel (CSE): Draft acknowledgement sent to impacted customers (internal copy attached to the incident doc).
Oncall Bot: Incident 2026-03-14-03:12 transitioned to: action-items-tracking.
Sam Mitchell: Closing out the thread here — thanks team. I'll update the incident doc with the owners and deadlines. If anyone sees new customer escalations, ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
